facts.statement: Caihong was a small paravian theropod dinosaur that lived in China during the Late Jurassic period.
facts.quote: Caihong () is a genus of small paravian theropod dinosaur from China that lived during the Late Jurassic period.

facts.statement: The species Caihong juji was named and described in 2018 by Hu Dongyu, Julia A. Clarke, Chad M. Eliason, Qiu Rui, Li Quanguo, Matthew D. Shawke, Zhao Cuilin, Liliana D'Alba, Jiang Jinkai, and Xu Xing.
facts.quote: In 2018, the type species Caihong juji was named and described by Hu Dongyu, Julia A. Clarke, Chad M. Eliason, Qiu Rui, Li Quanguo, Matthew D. Shawke, Zhao Cuilin, Liliana D'Alba, Jiang Jinkai and Xu Xing.

facts.statement: The genus name Caihong means "rainbow" in Mandarin, referring to the fossil's splendor and the range of new scientific insights it provided.
facts.quote: The generic name is the Mandarin caihong, 彩虹, "rainbow", in reference to the splendor of the fossil and the spectrum of new scientific insights it offers.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a complete articulated skeleton with preserved soft tissues and extensive remains of plumage.
facts.quote: It consists of a complete articulated skeleton, compressed on a slab and counterslab. Soft tissues and extensive remains of the plumage have been preserved.

facts.statement: Caihong was a small dinosaur estimated to be 40 cm long and weigh 475 grams.
facts.quote: Caihong was a rather small dinosaur. Its length was estimated at 40 cm, and its weight at 475 g.

facts.statement: Caihong had an estimated wingspan of approximately 44 cm, based on a wing length of about 21 cm.
facts.quote: It is estimated to have a wingspan of approximately 44 cm, given that the wingspan is about 2.1 times the wing length which is about 21 cm.

facts.statement: Caihong possessed a prominent crest on the lacrimal bone that projected strongly above and sideways.
facts.quote: The lacrimal bone has a crest strongly projecting to above and sideways.

facts.statement: Caihong had a short ilium in its pelvis, measuring less than half the length of the femur, a trait unique among theropods.
facts.quote: In the pelvis, the ilium is short with a length less than half that of the femur (thighbone); in all other theropods the ilium is more than half as long.

facts.statement: The skull of Caihong measured 67.6 millimetres in length.
facts.quote: The skull of Caihong has a length of 67.6 millimetres.

facts.statement: Caihong had slender, tightly packed, recurved teeth in the front of its jaws, including the praemaxilla and anterior dentary.
facts.quote: The generally recurved teeth are more slender and tightly packed in the front of the jaws, such as in the praemaxilla and the anterior part of the dentary in the lower jaw.

facts.statement: The tooth row in Caihong's upper jaw was exceptionally long, extending below the front of the eye socket.
facts.quote: The tooth row in the upper jaw is exceptionally long, reaching to a position below the front of the eye socket.

facts.statement: The front teeth of Caihong, including the first maxillary teeth, lacked serrations.
facts.quote: The front teeth, including the first maxillary teeth, do not have serrations.

facts.statement: Caihong's arm was relatively short, measuring 60% of the hindlimb length.
facts.quote: The arm is relatively short, equal to 60% of the hindlimb length.

facts.statement: Caihong's ulna was longer than its upper arm, a trait generally limited to flying birds among theropods.
facts.quote: The ulna is longer than the upper arm, a trait which in theropods is generally limited to flying birds.

facts.statement: Caihong's hindlimb was very long, measuring 3.1 times the length of its torso.
facts.quote: The hindlimb is very long, 3.1 times as long as the torso.

facts.statement: Caihong's second toe bore a small retractable sickle claw.
facts.quote: The second toe bears a small retractable sickle claw.

facts.statement: Fossilized feathers of Caihong contained nanostructures interpreted as melanosomes similar to those producing black iridescent colors in modern birds.
facts.quote: The fossilized feathers of Caihong possessed nanostructures which were analyzed and interpreted as melanosomes, showing similarity to organelles that produce a black iridescent color in extant birds.

facts.statement: Caihong is classified within the family Anchiornithidae.
facts.quote: familia: Anchiornithidae

facts.statement: Caihong belongs to the order Saurischia.
facts.quote: ordo: Saurischia

facts.statement: Caihong was a very small dinosaur.
facts.quote: Caihong era un dinosaurio bastante pequeño.

facts.statement: Caihong was estimated to be 40 centimeters long and weigh 475 grams.
facts.quote: Su longitud se estimó en 40 centímetros, y su peso en 475 gramos.

facts.statement: Caihong was distinguished from related genera like Eosinopteryx and Anchiornis by prominent lacrimal crests, longer pennaceous feathers on its limbs, and tail feathers with large asymmetric vanes.
facts.quote: Caihong se distinguió especialmente de los géneros estrechamente relacionados de la biota de Yanliao, como Eosinopteryx y Anchiornis, por la presencia de prominentes crestas lagrimales, plumas pennaceas más largas en las extremidades anteriores y traseras y plumas de la cola con grandes aspas asimétricas.

facts.statement: Caihong likely had ten cervical vertebrae, thirteen dorsal vertebrae, five sacral vertebrae, and twenty tail vertebrae.
facts.quote: Caihong probablemente tiene diez vértebras cervicales, trece vértebras dorsales, cinco vértebras sacras y veinte vértebras de la cola.

facts.statement: Caihong had a short tail measuring 178 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: La cola es corta, con una longitud de 178 milímetros.

facts.statement: The skull of Caihong measured 67.6 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: El cráneo de Caihong tiene una longitud de 67,6 milímetros.

facts.statement: In front of the eye orbit, Caihong's lacrimal bone had a long, robust horn-like process that curved upward at its tip.
facts.quote: Delante de esta órbita, el hueso lagrimal tiene un proceso largo y robusto parecido a un cuerno, orientado hacia los lados en su base y curvándose gradualmente hacia arriba en su punta.

facts.statement: Caihong's generally recurved teeth were thin and tightly packed at the front of the jaws.
facts.quote: Los dientes generalmente recurvados son más delgados y están apretados en la parte frontal de las mandíbulas, como en la premaxilar y la parte anterior de la mandíbula inferior.

facts.statement: Caihong's forelimb was relatively short, measuring 60% of the length of its hindlimb.
facts.quote: El brazo es relativamente corto, igual al 60% de la longitud de las extremidades posteriores.

facts.statement: Caihong's humerus was short at 42.1 millimeters, representing 60% of the femur length, compared to 100% in Anchiornis.
facts.quote: El húmero es corto, 42,1 milímetros de largo, con 60% de la longitud del hueso del muslo, en comparación con una proporción del 100% con Anchiornis.

facts.statement: Caihong's ulna was longer than its upper arm bone, a trait generally limited to flying theropods.
facts.quote: El cúbito es más largo que el brazo superior, un rasgo que en los terópodos generalmente se limita a las aves voladoras.

facts.statement: Caihong's femur was elongated and measured 70.9 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: El hueso del muslo es alargado y tiene una longitud de 70,9 milímetros.

facts.statement: Caihong's ischium measured 20.5 millimeters in length.
facts.quote: El isquion tiene una longitud de 20.5 milímetros.

facts.statement: Caihong's pubis was slightly directed backward and ended in a hook-shaped "foot," similar to Unenlagiinae.
facts.quote: El hueso púbico está ligeramente dirigido hacia atrás. Termina con un "pie" en forma de gancho, como con los Unenlagiinae.

facts.statement: Caihong's fossil is surrounded by a wide area of feathers, with only the snout and claws discovered.
facts.quote: El fósil está rodeado por una amplia zona de plumas, solo se descubren el hocico y las garras.

facts.statement: Caihong's body contour feathers were relatively longer than those of other non-avian dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Las plumas del contorno del cuerpo de Caihong son relativamente más largas que las de otros dinosaurios no aviares.

facts.statement: Fossilized Caihong feathers possessed nanostructures interpreted as melanosomes, similar to those producing iridescent black color in existing birds.
facts.quote: Las plumas fosilizadas de Caihong poseen nanoestructuras que se analizaron e interpretaron como melanosomas, mostrando similitud con los organelos que producen un color negro iridiscente en las aves existentes.

facts.statement: Caihong represents the oldest known evidence of platelet melanosomes.
facts.quote: Caihong representa la evidencia más antigua conocida de melanosomas plaquetarios.

facts.statement: A farmer named Yang Jun discovered a small theropod skeleton in a quarry near the village of Nanshimenzi in northern Hebei province.
facts.quote: El campesino Yang Jun de Gangou, Qinglong, al norte de la provincia de Hebei, descubrió en una cantera cerca del pueblo de Nanshimenzi el esqueleto de un terópodo pequeño

facts.statement: The fossil was acquired by the Liaoning Provincial Institute of Paleontology in February 2014.
facts.quote: Fue adquirido en febrero de 2014 por el Museo Paleontológico de Liaoning

facts.statement: The species Caihong juji was named and described in 2018 based on these fossils.
facts.quote: Estos fósiles fueron la base para nombrar y describir en 2018 a la especie tipo Caihong juji

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is cataloged as PMoL-B00175 at the Liaoning Provincial Institute of Paleontology.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo, alojado en el Museo Paleontológico de Liaoning con el número de catálogo PMoL-B00175

facts.statement: The fossil represents an adult individual.
facts.quote: El fósil corresponde a un individuo adulto

facts.statement: The fossil consists of a complete articulated skeleton preserved in a slab with face and reverse sides, including soft tissues and feather remains.
facts.quote: Consiste de un esqueleto completo articulado, comprimido en una losa con cara y contracara, en la que se preservaron además tejidos blandos y varios restos del plumaje

facts.statement: Caihong is distinguished from related genera like Eosinopteryx and Anchiornis by prominent lacrimal crests, longer pennaceous feathers on both forelimbs and hindlimbs, and tail feathers with large asymmetric barbs.
facts.quote: Este dinosaurio particular puede ser distinguido de otros géneros cercanamente relacionados como Eosinopteryx y Anchiornis por la presencia de crestas lagrimales prominentes, plumas penáceas más largas tanto en las extremidades delanteras como posteriores y plumas de la cola con grandes barbas asimétricas

facts.statement: Analysis of feather nanostructures suggests melanosomes similar to those producing iridescent colors in modern birds, making it the oldest evidence of this trait.
facts.quote: El análisis de las nanoestructuras de los fósiles de las plumas llevaron a interpretar que los melanosomas muestran similitudes con los mismos organelos que producen colores iridiscentes en las aves actuales, lo cual lo convierte en la más antigua evidencia de esta característica

facts.statement: Caihong is classified within the group Paraves.
facts.quote: Caihong se coloca en Paraves

facts.statement: Different cladistic analyses have produced conflicting results regarding the phylogenetic tree structure.
facts.quote: Diferentes análisis cladísticos tuvieron diferentes resultados en la estructura del árbol genealógico

facts.statement: In one analysis, Caihong was placed as a sister species to Xiaotingia within a comb-like clade formed with Troodontidae and Dromaeosauridae.
facts.quote: En un análisis, que era Caihong las especies hermanas de Xiaotingia, dentro de un clado que se formó un peine con Troodontidae y Dromaeosauridae

facts.statement: Under certain definitions, the groups Paraves and Aves overlap.
facts.quote: Bajo ciertas definiciones, Paraves y Aves coinciden

facts.statement: In another analysis, Caihong was placed in Anchiorninae as a member of Troodontidae.
facts.quote: En otro análisis, Caihong cayó en Anchiorninae como miembros de Troodontidae

facts.statement: Caihong lived during the Oxfordian stage, approximately 161.5 to 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Oxfordian to Oxfordian (161.5 to 154.8 million years ago)
